Name: DE-History
Statement:
select  hst.Oid as HistoryId,
        hst.DocumentTypeName as DocumentType,
        hst.DocumentOid as DocumentId,
        Version,
        hst.StartDate,
        hst.EndDate,
        hst.Motive,
        usr.Id as UserId,
        usr.Name as [User],
        usr.HasImage as UserHasImage,
        Action,
        wfs.Oid as StageId,
        wfs.Name as Stage,
        wfs.Color as StageColor,
        wst.Oid as StageTypeId,
        wst.Name as StageType,
        wst.Color as StageTypeColor,
        CreatedOnUtc
from    History hst
            join UserLookup usr on usr.Id = hst.[User]
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = hst.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
where   hst.GCRecord is null
